name: Find a Slot
description: Book four meetings at the earliest possible time for a team spread across London, New York, Toronto, Lisbon, Warsaw, Johannesburg, Dubai, Mumbai, Singapore and Sydney: working hours, existing meetings, focus time, in-person appointments with travel time either side, a shared London meeting room, the no-meetings-on-Friday-afternoon rule, public holidays, a calendar update that arrives later and, in the hardest cases, weeks in which the clocks change and meetings that must be booked one after another. Every answer is the provably earliest start, found by two independent solvers.
hook: Five people, four time zones, the week the clocks change. When is the earliest slot that works?
author: Gauntlet Core
